Daily Quiz.question: ১) The author of 'An Essay on Man' is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet.
- His famous epic is The Rape of the Lock.
- His notable works:
• An Essay on Criticism,
• The Dunciad,
• The Imitation of Horace,
• An Essay on Man,
• Letter to Gay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects' was said by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Francis Bacon is the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
- His famous quotations:
- Unmarried men are best friends, best Masters, best servants but not always best subjects.
- Wonder is the seed of knowledge.
- Opportunity makes a thief.
- It is impossible to love and be wise.
- History makes man wise.
- Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom.
- Revenge is a kind of wild justice.
- Studies serve for delight, for ornament and for ability.
- Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested of studies.
- Reading maketh a full man, conference a ready man, written an exact man.
- The secret of success is the constancy of purpose.
- Old wood best to burns, old wine to drink, old friends to trust and old author to read.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and The Oxford Dictionary of Quotation.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who wrote the novel 'Tom Jones'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Henry Fielding regarded as 'Father of English Novel'.
• His famous novels:
- Tom Jones,
- Amelia,
- Joseph Andrews,
- Jonathan Wilde,
- Top Secret.
• His famous plays:
- Rape Upon Rape,
- The Temple Beau,
- The Tragedy of Tragedies,
- The Modern Husband.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) The epic 'The Rape of the Lock' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet.
• His famous epic is 'The Rape of the Lock'.
• His notable works:
- An Essay on Criticism,
- The Dunciad,
- The Imitation of Horace,
- An Essay on Man,
- Letter to Gay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who is the author of 'The Citizen of the World'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Oliver Goldsmith is an Irish novelist, playwright and poet.
• His famous works:
- The Citizen of the World,
- The Vicar of the Wakefield,
- The Traveller,
- The Deserted Village,
- The good Natured Man,
- She Stoops to Conquer.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who is called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- John Milton is called Epic Poet.
- He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
- 'Lycidas' is his famous Elegy.
- His famous epics:
• Paradise Lost and
• Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who wrote the book 'The Mistaken Husband'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism.
• His famous works:
- All for Love,
- The Indian Emperor,
- Aureng-Zebe,
- The Mistaken Husband,
- Absalom and Achitophel,
- MacFlecknoe,
- The essay of Dramatic Poesy,
- The Conquest of Granada,
- The Medal of John Bays.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) The first novel of English literature, Pamela, is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Pamela or Virtue Rewarded, the first English novel, is written by Samuel Richardson.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who is famous for 'Comedy of Manners'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners.
• His famous plays:
- The Way of The World,
- Love for Love,
- The Double Dealer,
- The Old Bachelor etc.
• On the other hand, Ben Jonson is famous for comedy of humors.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) The first comedy of English literature is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Ralph Roister Doister, the first English comedy, is written by Nicholas Udall.
- Gorboduc, the first English tragedy, is written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
- Pamela or Virtue Rewarded, the first novel of English Literature, is written by Samuel Richardson.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) The novel 'Ressalas' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Dr. Samuel Jonson is the Father of English Dictionary.
- He is the first lexicographer in English.
- His famous books:
• A Preface to Shakespeare,
• Rasselas: Prince of Abissinia,
• The False Alarm,
• The Adventure,
• Life of the English Poets etc.
- His famous poem:
• The Vanity of Human Wishes.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The greatest satirist of the 18th century is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Jonathan Swift is the greatest satirist of the 18th century.
• His famous works:
- Gulliver's Travels,
- A tale of a Tub,
- The Battle of the Books,
- A Modest Proposal,
- A Journey to Stella.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who is the author of 'Holy Living'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Jeremy Taylor was a cleric in the Church of England who achieved fame as an author during the Protectorate of Oliver Cromwell.
• His famous books:
- Holy Living
- Holy Dying
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) The book 'Leviathan' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Thomas Hobbes is a political philosopher in the Commonwealth Period of English literature.
- His famous book is Leviathan.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Who is the author of 'The Recruiting Officer'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- George Farquhar was an Irish dramatist.
- His notable plays:
- The Constant Couple,
- The Recruiting Officer and
- The Beaux' Stratagem.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) The author of 'The Duchess of Malfi' is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
• John Webster is the poet of the Jacobean period.

• His famous tragedies:
- The Duchess of Malfi,
- The White Devil,
- The Devil's Law Case etc.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) The novel 'Robinson Cruse' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Daniel Defoe is a famous novelist.
- His famous novels:
• Captain Singleton,
• Robinson Cruse.
• His notable poem:
- The True-Born Englishman.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is the author of 'Arcadia'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Sir Philip Sidney is a famous critic, poet and soldier.
- His famous books:
- Arcadia (A book that bears the embryo of English Novel),
- The Lady of May,
- An Apology for Poetry.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) The Earliest Epic in English literature is-
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Beowulf is the earliest epic in English literature (England).
- It is also the first monument in English literature.
- The author of 'Beowulf' is Anonymous.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote the book 'Hudibras'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Samuel Butler was an English novelist and critic.
- He is the writer of the Restoration Period.
- His famous satire in verse is Hudibras.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.
